name: Dao sour pork
summary: Dao belly pork scored, salted, and packed with leftover rice until it sours in a jar. Eat it with lá lốt, at a feast or when guests come.
origin: Dao households, in the 21 March 2020 museum handbook. Báo Sơn La, 9 September 2025.
howToEat: From the jar, with lá lốt. A souring time is Check on arrival. The handbook says Tết and guest meals, not a daily stall.
where: Dao households. No ward was named. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Dao sour pork in Son La — belly soured in a jar
seoDescription: Thịt chua người Dao in Sơn La. Belly pork, salt, leftover rice, and a jar, eaten with lá lốt at Tết and for guests.
